Teamtailor is growing in North America, and we’re looking for a Head of Marketing to define how we win here. You’ll be our first senior marketing leader on the ground representing US & Canada, setting the NA marketing strategy and acting as the voice of the market to our global teams in Sweden.

Build and own the NA marketing strategy

item.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager - Chicago
item.description:
Join us to shape the future!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 200,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

As a Strategic Partnerships Manager at Teamtailor, you'll be the founding force behind our North American partner ecosystem, a role that combines tech and channel partnerships to drive real commercial impact in the US. This is a builder's role with serious revenue upside, you'll take Teamtailor's global partnerships strategy and playbook and bring it to life locally.

The role

We have a handful of partners in the US already but in terms of a structured revenue generating ecosystem, we're starting from scratch and we are looking for the right player to help build the market. You'll be part of our global Partnerships team, and your core job is to take our global strategy and playbook and deploy it at a local level, adapting it to what works in the US market.

item.title: Revenue Systems Engineer
item.description:
Join us to shape the future!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

Working at Teamtailor means being part of a dynamic, fast-paced tech company that values impact and responsibility. Our workplace fosters an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully to the growth of the company. 🎉🥳

About the role

The Revenue Systems Engineer designs, builds and maintains the configuration, logic and integrations that run our revenue systems.

Revenue Systems runs the tools that about 440 people across many teams use every day, from Sales and Customer Success to Finance and Data: Salesforce as our hub, and around it tools for conversation intelligence, scheduling, enrichment, contracts, billing and customer success. We are turning the team into a product team, where each tool has an owner, a direction and outcomes we measure.

In this role, you work across the whole stack: Salesforce configuration and code, integrations between our tools, and the data that flows through them. You are involved early in discovery and take solutions all the way to production.
